work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Station utility power failure at ~18:04 with ambient -8F. PLC/comms on UPS. Heat trace on instrument rack and sensing lines runs on utility power and is now lost - high risk of frozen sensing lines/false pressure indications; methanol pump and scrubber dump status uncertain (non-essential loads shed). Need on-site verification of instruments, methanol injection, scrubber, and restoration of power/heat trace (check generator/utility).
